user.title: Atmeex Cloud
user.description: Sign in with the account you use in the Atmeex mobile app. All brizers linked to it will be added automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Atmeex Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {email} has expired. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Atmeex cloud. Check your credentials and whether api.iot.atmeex.com is responding.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Atmeex account is already configured.

data_description.enable_cool: Offer HVAC cool mode — only for complexes that actually support cooling.
data_description.local_enabled: Accept direct connections from the brizers instead of relying only on cloud polling. Requires redirecting ws.iot.atmeex.com to this Home Assistant — see the README.
data_description.local_port: Port Home Assistant listens on for brizer connections. The devices always dial 3001, so change it only if that port is taken and you remap it on the router.
data_description.co2_sensor: Auto follows the readings: A7 only carries a CO₂ sensor in the higher trims, and a missing one always reports 0 ppm — air never does. Override if your unit's sensor is faulty or the detection got it wrong.
data_description.humidifier: Auto follows the readings: room humidity only arrives on units that have the humidifier. Override to force the humidity slider on or off.
